title: RigUtilization
description: Defines when the Rig is on/off location and the hole section depths related to the operations being performed by the rig.

RigSpecificationsID.title: Rig Specifications ID
RigSpecificationsID.description: The specifications or configuration of the rig at the time it is being utilized to drill this depth range of this section.

HoleSectionID.title: Hole Section ID
HoleSectionID.description: Identifier of the Hole Section that is being drilled

StartHoleDepth.title: Start Hole Depth
StartHoleDepth.description: Measured depth of the wellbore when operations performed with this rig started. Depth relative to Planned wellbore ZDP. Navigate via HoleSectionId and WellboreID to the side-car WellPlanningWellbore, which holds the depth reference in data.VerticalMeasurement.

EndHoleDepth.title: End Hole Depth
EndHoleDepth.description: Measured depth of the wellbore when operations performed with this rig ended. Depth relative to Planned wellbore ZDP. Navigate via HoleSectionId and WellboreID to the side-car WellPlanningWellbore, which holds the depth reference in data.VerticalMeasurement.

StartDateActivity.title: Dtm Start
StartDateActivity.description: The start date and time when operations performed with this rig started (Rig on location date)

EndDateActivity.title: Dtm End
EndDateActivity.description: The end date and time when operations performed with this rig ended. (Rig off location date)

AirGaps.title: Air Gaps
AirGaps.description: Air gap from the rig floor to the ground or mean sea level, depending on the rig location. This is typically a static number and will have only one record in the array, but can change in offshore operations when the rig is raised or lowered.

items.title: Air Gap
items.description: Air gap from the rig floor to the ground or mean sea level, depending on the rig location.

StartDate.title: Start Date
StartDate.description: The start date and time the air gap measurement takes affect on the rig.

EndDate.title: End Date
EndDate.description: The end date and time  the air gap measurement takes affect on the rig.

AirGap.title: Air Gap
AirGap.description: Air gap from the rig floor to the ground or mean sea level, depending on the rig location.
